name: Umnyy dom na ESP32
steps: Podklyuchite klaviaturu, datchik DHT22 i OLED-displey k plate ESP32 soglasno skheme.
Podklyuchite servo-privod i pyezo-dinamik k sootvetstvuyushchim tsifrovym pinam.
Ustanovite neobhodimye biblioteki dlya raboty s Keypad, DHT, Servo i OLED-displeem v Arduino IDE.
